Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer mistakenly identified the director of the film "Ręce Do Góry" (Hands Up!) as Jerzy Skolimowski without verifying if there were any alternative films or directors associated with the title. While the initial search correctly identified Jerzy Skolimowski as the director of the 1967 film, the Planner's earlier analysis had noted that "there are potentially multiple films with the title 'Ręce Do Góry'" and instructed WebSurfer to confirm the year and alternate titles before proceeding. WebSurfer failed to address this ambiguity, which led to the assumption that the 1967 film was the correct one without verifying if there were other films with the same name. This oversight could result in an incorrect answer if the user intended to inquire about a different film with the same title.
